note: IPO supply and conflict calendar. Lock-up releases put insider supply on the market; the underwriters' research quiet period ends 10 days after an IPO (FINRA Rule 2241) and their analysts' initiations are conflicted coverage (the banks earned the fees; their clients hold the shares). Dates computed from the IPO date where the prospectus states days - verify against the final prospectus (424B4).
